name: Glass Cannon
text: All damage you deal is amplified by 25%. All damage you take is amplified by 50%.

name: Obliterate
text: Critical hits stack 1% weapon damage up to 25 times. Counted at full stacks.

name: Spotter
text: Amplifies weapon and skill damage to pulsed enemies by 15%.

name: Intimidate
text: With bonus armor you amplify damage to enemies within 10m by 35%.

name: Unbreakable
text: When armor is depleted repair most of it. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Kinetic Momentum
text: Active skills stack skill damage and repair. Counted at full stacks.

name: Vigilance
text: 25% weapon damage. Taking damage disables it for 4 seconds.

name: Wicked
text: Applying a status effect grants 18% weapon damage for 20 seconds.

name: Composure
text: 15% weapon damage while in cover.

name: Companion
text: 15% weapon damage while within 5m of an ally or skill.

name: Combined Arms
text: Shooting an enemy grants 25% skill damage for 3 seconds.

name: Tech Support
text: Skill kills grant 25% skill damage for 20 seconds.

name: Bloodsucker
text: Kills stack bonus armor. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Press the Advantage
text: Striker's Gamble stacks give 0.9% weapon damage instead of 0.65%. Counted at 100 stacks.

name: Risk Management
text: Striker's Gamble can reach 200 stacks. Counted at 200 stacks.

name: Headache
text: More bonus armor per Heartstopper stack. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Cold
text: Heartstopper stacks give 1.1% weapon damage instead of 1%. Counted at 50 stacks.

name: Endless Hunger
text: Apex Predator buffs last longer. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Overwhelming Force
text: Apex Predator kills also apply a disorient in a wider area. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Target Rich Environment
text: Mark up to 5 enemies. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Critical Measures
text: More damage is shared between marked enemies. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Process Refinery
text: Makeshift Repairs works faster. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Improved Materials
text: Makeshift Repairs repairs more. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Tactical Superiority
text: Ground Control gives 25% damage instead of 15%.

name: Advanced Combat Tactics
text: Ground Control lasts longer. Not counted in the numbers.
